Due to being functionally replaced with map markers, using Beacons for markers is a waste of resources, as placing markers directly is free. It can be found throughout the World and is the most common out of all edibles. It can be searched with the Object Scanner after researching it in the MAM, and can be used to craft the Medicinal Inhaler.

fields.description: An explosive powder that is commonly used in explosives and cartridges.

title: Caterium Ore

fields.description: Caterium Ore is smelted into Caterium Ingots. Caterium Ingots are mostly used for advanced electronics.

intro: Caterium Ore is a semi-rare early-game ore found in the world. It is smelted into Caterium Ingots for further processing. It is analogous to real-life gold or silver.

fields.description: Circuit Boards are advanced electronics that are used in a plethora of different ways.

title: Hover Pack

fields.description: Power consumption: 100 MW; Allows for vertical movement and hovering in mid-air to improve building efficiency and factory traversal. Wirelessly connects to nearby power connections, such as Power Poles and Buildings, for power consumption.; Slow-fall: Hold ascend input after losing connection mid-air.; Disable Hoverpack: Double tap descend input while hovering.

intro: The Hover Pack is late-game personal flight equipment that feeds on nearby Power Line connectors (on Power Poles and Buildings) and Railways. It allows pioneers to hover endlessly, as long as they are within range of a powered structure. Pioneers can use it to gain elevation and increase their interaction range to make factory building easier.

title: Somersloop

fields.description: A strange alien thing with a mind-bending yet somehow familiar shape.

intro: Somersloops are alien artifacts found throughout the world that have multiple uses such as multiplying production, use for power production, and more. They emit a red glow and unusual particles, as well as a pulsating sound that cycles through being loud and quiet. Standing next to one for an extended period of time will result in a voice being heard, urging the player to harvest it.

intro: Stator is a crafting component used to craft Motors and various other recipes.

title: Statue

fields.name: Adequate Pioneering
fields.description: The statue of the Running Character.

intro: Statues are decorative items that can be placed on the floor. They can be purchased in the AWESOME Shop with Coupons. Since statues tend to be expensive, it is advised to unlock all other blueprints such as buildings and special vehicles first.

fields.description: Steel Beams are used most often when constructing a little more advanced buildings.

title: Steel Ingot

fields.description: Steel Ingots are made from Iron Ore that's been smelted with Coal. They are made into several parts used in building construction.

intro: Steel Ingots are smelted from Iron Ore and Coal in Foundries. They are mainly used to produce Steel Pipes and Steel Beams.

title: Sulfur

fields.description: Sulfur is primarily used for Black Powder.

intro: Sulfur is a rare mid-game resource found in the world. It is used for Black Powder, Compacted Coal and some late-game parts.

title: Supercomputer

fields.description: The supercomputer is the next-gen version of the computer.

intro: The Supercomputer is a late-game component used to construct Programmable Splitters, Geothermal Generators and Nuclear Power Plants.

title: Superposition Oscillator

fields.description: A Superposition Oscillator is an oscillator circuit that uses the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal to create a string vibration with a precise frequency.; Often used in teleportation technology and dimensional manipulation.

intro: The Superposition Oscillator is an item that can be obtained from the FICSMAS Advent Calendar in the HUB. It appears to be the successor to Crystal Oscillators. Currently, it can only be used to unlock two Crash Sites.

title: Turbo Motor

fields.description: The Turbo Motor is a more complex, and more powerful, version of the regular Motor.

intro: Turbo Motor is a late-game component used for building the Miner Mk.3 and Particle Accelerator.

title: Uranium

fields.description: Uranium is a radioactive element.; Used to produce Encased Uranium Cells for Uranium Fuel Rods.; Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

intro: Uranium is a rare late-game resource found in the world. It is involved in the Uranium Fuel Rod production, and gives off radiation.

title: Wire

fields.description: Used for crafting.; One of the most basic parts.

intro: Wire is the most basic product from Copper, alongside Copper Sheets. It is commonly used in power infrastructure.

title: Wood

fields.description: Primarily used as fuel. Biomass Burners and vehicles can use it for power.

intro: Wood is a biomass resource harvested from bushes and trees around the world. It can be crafted into Biomass, which can be used as fuel in Biomass Burners or vehicles. It can be further refined into more energy-efficient Solid Biofuel which is used to fuel the Chainsaw.

title: Xeno-Basher

fields.description: Heavy electroshock self defense weapon for melee range.

intro: The Xeno-Basher is a melee weapon that shocks enemies, dealing 9 damage. It is a direct upgrade of the , with greater range and damage. Thus, it is advised to unlock and craft it as soon as possible. It also guarantees a stagger when it hits a charging Hog.

title: Xeno-Zapper

fields.description: Standard issue electroshock self defense weapon for melee range.

intro: The Xeno-Zapper is a short-range melee weapon that shocks enemies, dealing five damage.

title: Zipline

fields.description: Slot: Hand; Provides faster traversal in factories by allowing Pioneers to zip along Power Lines.; Activate the Zipline and aim at a nearby Power Line to connect to it.

intro: The Zipline is an early-game hand piece of equipment that can be used for navigating along Power Lines. Despite statements in pre-release teasers, it is not necessary for the Power Line to be powered, meaning it can be effectively used for exploration or crossing gaps.
